name: Sayonara no Hohoemi 2 ~Kioku no Tsubasa ni Miserarete~
original_name: さよならの微笑み2～記憶の翼に魅せられて～
source:
Main characters takes part in a school circle to build a human-powered aircraft for the summer tournament in a month's time. Collision of minds, sour and sweet emotions fill their everyday life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公参加学校社团，准备在一个月后的夏季比赛中制造人力飞机。思绪碰撞、酸甜情感充斥着他们的日常生活。
